lines.t: Verse 1
The sun is sinking, colors in the sky,
Everything slows down, I don’t have to try.
All the rushing fades, I can finally breathe,
Like the weight I carried just loosens off of me.
Pre-Chorus 1
I don’t have to worry, I don’t have to run,
Six days are over, and now the rest has come.
Chorus
On the Sabbath I feel at peace,
I can rest and I feel at ease.
Six days I carry my cross,
But on the seventh I cease.
Shabbat shalom, my soul is still,
All my striving bends to Your will.
Shabbat shalom, I feel the sabbath peace.
Verse 2
No more counting all the things to do,
No more trying just to make it through.
I lay down every worry,
And I feel Your presence right next to me.
Pre-Chorus 2
Every worry gently slips away,
As I step into this holy day.
Chorus
On the Sabbath I feel at peace,
I can rest and I feel at ease.
Six days I carry my cross,
But on the seventh I cease.
Shabbat shalom, my soul is still,
All my striving bends to Your will.
Shabbat shalom, I feel the sabbath peace.
Bridge
I remember the sabbath, and You remember me,
In the stillness of Your love, I am finally free.
I will love one another, as You have loved me,
In Your mercy, in Your grace, is where I will be.
Six long days, now the seventh has come,
And I rest in the presence of the Holy One.
Final Chorus
On the Sabbath I feel at peace,
I can rest and I feel at ease.
Six days I carry my cross,
But on the seventh I cease.
Shabbat shalom, my soul is still,
All my striving bends to Your will.
Shabbat shalom, I feel the sabbath peace.
Shabbat shalom, I feel the sabbath peace.
